verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs describe a drop-in OpenAI replacement. You point an existing OpenAI SDK at https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai and use a DeepInfra token as the API key, with no other code changes. The docs also say the model name must be set to one from DeepInfra's catalog, which is a small step beyond 'only base URL and API key'. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that SDK code works unchanged, and no model-name change being required.
